probe: qa_ui_performance.py, 8 samples per variant, two reversed order blocks, 1440x900 Chromium

replays.observation: Outlier replay; DOM and decision-shell means were faster for R4, but map readiness was slower in 7/8 pairs.
Fresh balanced replay on a separately restarted R4 server; map readiness was slower in 3/8 pairs and no map sample exceeded the 200ms material threshold.

investigation.action: Replayed with current-main and actual R2 servers, restarted R4 server on a fresh port, and retained only the exact second-run report as performance.json.
investigation.conclusion: The first result was not reproducible; R4 does not reproduce the R2 +498ms/8-of-8 slower pattern. The remaining local timing variance is recorded for independent/hosted review.
